name: motion-drawer
title: Motion Drawer
description: A reference-faithful edge drawer, floating quick panel, layered workspace and bottom action tray.

props.name: side
props.description: Logical edge, resolved against dir. Bottom trays always dismiss downward.

props.name: variant
props.description: Edge navigation, content-sized panel, layered workspace or bottom action tray.

props.name: width
props.description: Panel width in pixels, bounded to the viewport. Defaults: 300 / 360 / 540 / 640.

props.name: dragThreshold
props.description: Fraction of the panel to drag toward its edge before dismissing (0.1–0.9).

props.name: buttonOpeningVariants
props.description: The trigger joins the close control, pushes toward the edge, or fades in place.

props.name: animationConfig
props.type: { stiffness?: number; damping?: number; mass?: number }
props.description: Spring tuning; ignored when motion is disabled.

props.name: panels
props.description: Mounted, selectable card surfaces for the stack variant.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Reusable custom launcher. Its own disabled state is respected.
